Watts made this hymn from Psalm 99, "in the language of the New Testament": a paraphrase, not a translation. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

1The LORD reigns; let the nations tremble! He is enthroned above the cherubim; let the earth quake! 2Great is the LORD in Zion; He is exalted above all the peoples. 3Let them praise Your great and awesome name— He is holy! 4The mighty King loves justice. You have established equity; You have exercised justice and righteousness in Jacob. … 5 more verses PSALM 99 · ITS FIRST VERSES · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ PSALM 99
The God Jehovah reigns, Let all the nations fear, Let sinners tremble at his throne, And saints be humble there. STANZA I
